title: Command Annotation Schema V2
description: Schema for defining annotations that group an arbitrary number of commands together.

id.description: A unique identifier for a command annotation.

source.description: The type of annotation (for machine parsing)

parent.description: The parent annotation of this annotation, if any.

params.description: key value pairs of the parameters that were passed to the second order command that this annotates

userSpecifiedName.description: The optional user-specified name of the second order command

userSpecifiedDescription.description: The optional user-specified description of the second order command
